==English==

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈmɛθəd/}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈmɛtət/|a=Dublin}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-method.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɛθəd|s=2}}
* {{hyphenation|en|meth|od}}

===Etymology 1===
{{etymon|en|:bor|frm:methode|tree=1}}
{{root|en|ine-pro|*sed-}}
From {{bor|en|frm|methode}}, from {{der|en|la|methodus}}, from {{der|en|grc|μέθοδος}}. {{surf|en|met-|-hod}}. See also [[-ode]] and [[hodo-]].

====Noun====
{{en-noun|~}}

# {{lb|en|countable}} A [[process]] by which a [[task]] is [[completed]]; a way of doing something (followed by the [[adposition]] [[of]], [[to]] or [[for]] before the purpose of the process).
#: {{ux|en|If one '''method''' doesn't work, you should ask a friend to help you.}}
#* {{RQ:Maxwell Mirror and the Lamp|chapter=3|passage=He at once secured attention by his informal '''method''', and when presently the coughing of Jarvis {{...}} interrupted the sermon, he altogether captivated his audience with a remark about cough lozenges being cheap and easily procurable.}}
# {{lb|en|uncountable}} [[systematicity|Systematicity]], [[methodicalness]], [[intentionality]], [[order]].
#* {{RQ:Shakespeare Hamlet|act=II|scene=ii|page=261|column=2|passage=Though this be madneſſe, / Yet there is '''Method''' in 't: {{...}}}}
# {{lb|en|acting|often "the method"}} A technique for [[acting]] based on the ideas articulated by {{w|Konstantin Stanislavski}} and focusing on authentically experiencing the inner life of the character being portrayed.
#: {{syn|en|method acting}}
# {{senseid|en|object-oriented programming}} {{lb|en|object-oriented}} A [[subroutine]] or [[function]] belonging to a [[class]] or [[object]].
#: {{syn|en|member function}}
# {{lb|en|slang}} [[marijuana|Marijuana]].
#: {{syn|en|Thesaurus:marijuana}}
# {{lb|en|dated}} An [[instruction]] [[book]] systematically arranged.
